messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Megan Lee <megan.lee@thedocfirm.com>, compliance@thedocfirm.com
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2: IAM evidence sampling — day-of plan and log queries

Hi Megan / Compliance team,

Thanks again for partnering with us for Acme Health's SOC 2 evidentiary sampling next week. Per our intake call, we'd like to confirm the run-of-day plan so we can stage exports and have owners on standby. Proposed plan below — please flag any additional queries you need.

Day-of plan (June 10)
- 09:00 PT: Start SCIM delta export (last 30 days) — target file: scim_delta_sample.csv
- 10:30 PT: Pull recent SAML assertion logs for 24-hr window (samples + metadata) — saml_assertion_samples.txt
- 12:00 PT: Snapshot of role-to-owner mapping and RBAC assignments — role_owner_matrix.xlsx (we'll include ephemeral admin annotations)
- 13:30 PT: Provide session token issuance metrics and just-in-time admin events (last 7 days)

Log scope & filters we plan to run
- SCIM: include create/update/delete events, include externalId and enterpriseId attributes, export with iso timestamps
- SAML: include Issuer, Subject, NameID, Assertion Consumer Service URL, and authentication context; redact ephemeral session IDs on export unless requested
- RBAC/roles: include role_id, role_name, direct_members, service_account_bindings, owner_email, last_owner_confirmation_date

Owners on standby: Jonas (provisioning), Ben (entitlement telemetry), Irene (SAML traces). We'll SSH to the export host and drop files in the shared Drive folder linked below.

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDE-example-privileged
Jira: SEC-4821 (we'll attach export deliverables and cross-reference)

Attachments: prototypes of the CSV/TSV header rows attached for your review.

If you'd like additional columns or a different time window, say so by Friday EOD (2025-06-06).

Thanks,
Ava Chen
Manager, Customer Security Operations
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment stub: scim_delta_sample.csv (header-only)

From: Megan Lee <megan.lee@thedocfirm.com>

Date: Tue, 03 Jun 2025 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2: IAM evidence sampling — day-of plan and log queries

Thanks Ava — that schedule looks good and granular, appreciate the lead time. A couple of clarifications/questions before we lock times: 

1) For the SCIM delta export, can you include a column for "lastKnownRole" where available? That helps our sampling logic when correlating deltas to role changes.
2) For SAML assertions: we will request full assertion bodies for 5 representative events. Please indicate if any of those assertions contain PII so we can coordinate redaction rules in advance.
3) On RBAC matrix: include service account bindings as a separate tab if possible — auditors often request a quick pivot on those.

Finally, for chain-of-custody, we'll need a signed checksum (SHA256) of each file when produced; an internal owner (Jonas or Ben) can paste the checksum into SEC-4821.

If all sounds good, we'll run the sampling at 14:00 ET (11:00 PT) but can shift if you prefer.

Megan Lee
Senior Auditor, The Doc Firm
megan.lee@thedocfirm.com

Ava / Megan — quick operational notes:

- We can add lastKnownRole to the SCIM CSV; it will be an additional column derived from our provisioning service's current snapshot. I will queue the export job and estimate a 25–30 minute runtime for the 30-day delta (we'll stream to the export host to avoid memory spikes).
- SAML assertions: we keep full assertion bodies in the secure log archive for 90 days. For the 5 representative events, we will pull the full assertion and run a quick PII scan (email, name, DOB). If PII is found we will tag and redact locally and provide a redaction report.
- RBAC matrix: Ben, can you confirm you have the service-account pivot tab ready and that it includes last_used timestamp? That helps sampling select recent service-account granting activity.

I'll post the SHA256 sums into SEC-4821 once files are pushed. Assuming no blockers, we'll aim for the 11:00 PT start Megan suggested.

Jonas Weber
Senior SRE, Identity & Access
Redwood Inference
